scripts.cf:preview: opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --var AUTH_MODE:none
scripts.cf:deploy: opennextjs-cloudflare build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: The collection database (D1). Created for you; keep the binding name `DB`.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com` (**Zero Trust → Settings**). The app refuses every request until Access is set up, so you can fill this in after the first deploy. See [Protect it with Access](https://github.com/scoobydrew83/brickfolio/blob/main/docs/cloudflare.md#3-choose-the-address-and-protect-it-with-cloudflare-access).

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: The **Application Audience (AUD) Tag** of the Access application in front of this Worker. Can be added after the first deploy.

CRON_SECRET.description: Any long random string, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. The daily sync uses it.

BRICKLINK_CONSUMER_KEY.description: From your [BrickLink API registration](https://www.bricklink.com/v2/api/register_consumer.page). Register the access token for IP `0.0.0.0`: Workers have no fixed IP.

REBRICKABLE_API_KEY.description: Optional: themes, minifig counts and "What can I build?". Free key from your Rebrickable profile → Settings → API.

BRICKSET_API_KEY.description: Optional: retail prices and retirement dates. Free key from brickset.com/tools/webservices/requestkey.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional: wishlist and retirement alerts to ntfy, Discord or any JSON webhook.

COMPARETHEBRICKS_API_KEY.description: Optional: barcode lookups for boxes the scanner has never seen.
